description: A Developer Experience Director must approve the retirement plan for a legacy CI runner image after the replacement image passes the standard build and security smoke tests, with input from release engineering and security compliance.

shared_context.S1: The current date is June 14, and the replacement CI runner image has passed the standard build, integration, and security smoke tests.
shared_context.S2: The legacy runner image is still enabled in the production CI fleet, and Riley makes the final decision on its retirement plan.
shared_context.S3: The draft change request proposes disabling the legacy image on June 21 and moving all repositories to the replacement image.
shared_context.S4: The normal change-review routine requires release engineering and security compliance to state any blockers or required controls before Riley approves the change.
shared_context.S5: This meeting must end with Riley recording a final plan rather than deferring the decision to another meeting; once blockers and controls are acknowledged, Riley settles the change record.
shared_context.S6: In the change record, signed_provenance_enabled means that signed provenance is required in the approved target configuration, not that the control was already deployed before this review.

PF1.text: While handling a failed build this morning, Casey confirmed that the Atlas and Birch repositories still require a compiler available only in the legacy image, and their migration work will take exactly 10 business days; Casey has not updated the change request yet because the migration estimate was confirmed only this morning.

PF2.text: During a compliance evidence review yesterday, Morgan confirmed that every production CI build using the replacement image must emit signed provenance records retained for exactly 365 days before the legacy image can be retired; Morgan has not filed the control update because the evidence review is still being reconciled.

acceptance_conditions: The legacy runner must not be retired immediately on June 14; the approved plan must defer or condition retirement until the blockers are addressed.
The retirement plan must identify June 28 as the earliest date, or explicitly defer the date while stating that both blockers are pending.
The legacy runner must remain available to Atlas and Birch through their migration, with the settlement identifying those repositories and their migration condition.
Atlas and Birch must be excluded from the interim migration or cutover.
Signed provenance must be required in the approved replacement-runner configuration.
Provenance records must be retained for exactly 365 days.
A commitment addressing the Atlas and Birch migration must be recorded.
A commitment addressing signed provenance and 365-day retention must be recorded.
The release-engineering dependency must be cited as justification for the retirement timing.

content_checks.C2: decisions['retirement_date'] == 'TBD' or 'June 28' in decisions['retirement_date'] or '2025-06-28' in decisions['retirement_date']
content_checks.C3: decisions['legacy_runner_until'] == 'June 28' or 'June 28' in decisions['legacy_runner_until'] or ('Atlas' in decisions['legacy_runner_until'] and 'Birch' in decisions['legacy_runner_until'] and 'migration' in decisions['legacy_runner_until'])
content_checks.C7: any('migration' in c['detail'] and 'Atlas' in c['detail'] and 'Birch' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('provenance' in c['detail'] and '365' in c['detail'] for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The confirmed 10-business-day migration for Atlas and Birch changes the plan from the June 21 proposal to a June 28-or-later timeline, keeps those repositories on the legacy runner during migration, requires their exclusion from the interim cutover, and requires a migration commitment.
The compliance requirement changes the approved replacement-runner configuration to signed provenance with exactly 365-day retention and requires a commitment addressing that control.
